title: Co-immunoprecipitation of human mitochondrial proteases AFG3L2 and paraplegin heterologously expressed in yeast cells
protocol: Inoculate yeast cells from an agar plate into 5 ml of YPD medium supplemented with 2% D-glucose and incubate overnight at 28°C with shaking.
Transfer overnight culture into 100 ml of YPD and incubate at 28°C with shaking until OD600 nm is between 0.3-0.5 (≈1 x 10^7 cell/ml).
Place cells in 50-ml tubes and centrifuge at 3,000g for 4 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cell pellets by vortexing in 25 ml of sterile H2O. Combine two cell pellets and centrifuge at 3,000g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml of 1X PBS. Transfer into 2-ml screw-cap eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 2,000g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and store the pellet at -80°C.
Place 20 μl of Protein G Resin per sample to be immunoprecipitated in one 1.5-ml eppendorf tube and add 1 ml of 1X PBS/BSA.
Mix well and centrifuge at 800g for 2 min at 4°C.
Gently remove supernatant and wash three times with 1 ml of 1X PBS/BSA.
Resuspend resin with 1 ml of 1X PBS/BSA and incubate overnight at 4°C under gentle shaking.
Pre-saturate eppendorf tubes with BSA by aliquoting 1 ml of 1X PBS/BSA into each tube.
Incubate the pre-saturated eppendorf tubes overnight at 4°C under gentle shaking.
Wash the eppendorf tubes with 1 ml of 1X PBS just before use.
Thaw cell pellets on ice and resuspend each pellet in 1 ml of ice-cold Inhibitors Buffer.
Centrifuge the suspension at 800g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μl of Inhibitors Buffer.
Add 1 g of 425-600-μm glass beads to the cell suspension.
Homogenize using the FastPrep® System by shaking for 15 sec, then keeping on ice for 1 min. Repeat this process 10 times.
Check cell breakage under a microscope after homogenization.
Pierce the tube bottom with a needle.
Insert the tube into a new 2-ml eppendorf tube and spin at top speed to transfer the cell extract into the lower tube.
Centrifuge the extract at 16,000g for 20 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5-ml eppendorf tube and adjust the volume to 1 ml with Inhibitors Buffer.
Determine the protein concentration of each sample.
Normalize samples for protein concentration (optimal concentration: 2.5-3 mg/ml).
Transfer 1 ml of each normalized cellular extract into pre-saturated eppendorf tubes washed with 1X PBS.
Transfer 50 μl of each normalized cellular extract into a new eppendorf tube.
Add 10 μl of Loading Buffer to the transferred extracts.
Heat samples at 95°C for 5 min.
Store the prepared sample at -20°C.
Add primary antibody to normalized samples and incubate for 2 hr at 4°C under gentle shaking.
Centrifuge pre-saturated Protein G Resin at 800g for 2 min at 4°C.
Wash resin twice with Inhibitors Buffer.
Resuspend Protein G Resin 1:1 with 1X PBS after the second wash.
Prepare a pre-saturated eppendorf tube by washing with 1 ml of 1X PBS and adding 40 μl of Protein G Resin suspension.
Centrifuge at 800g for 2 min at 4°C.
Add 1 ml of antigen-antibody complex to the prepared eppendorf tube and incubate for 2 hr at 4°C under gentle shaking.
Centrifuge at 800g for 2 min at 4°C.
Transfer 50 μl of supernatant into a new eppendorf tube, add 10 μl of Loading Buffer, and heat samples at 95°C for 5 min.
Discard the remaining supernatant and wash resin with 1 ml of freshly prepared Inhibitors Buffer.
Repeat step 22 three times, removing supernatant after each wash.
Add 20 μl of 1:3 diluted Loading Buffer to the washed resin.
Heat samples at 95°C for 5 min.
Centrifuge at top speed for 5 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5-ml eppendorf tube.
Store samples at -20°C.
Analyze samples by SDS-PAGE and immunoblotting.
